name: v0.5.23
body:
* Add GOG depot-based downloads, DLC installs, and incremental updates via gogdl integration
  * Add a repair option for GOG depot installs under "Install updates"
  * Add GOG cloud save synchronization
  * Add GameJolt as a game source
  * Add DLsite as a game source
  * Add store page URLs for GOG, Steam, itch.io, Humble Bundle, Flathub, ZOOM Platform, and GameJolt
  * Add Playtron import
  * Add parallel GOG download connections with resume support
  * Replace google-protobuf dependency with custom decoder for Battle.net
  * Improve Humble Bundle authentication and error handling
  * Offer both the Linux and Windows installers for Humble Bundle games
  * Fall back to the other OS's GOG installers when none match the runner
  * Show release dates for Amazon games
  * Improve EA App auth handling and logo compositing
  * Refresh expired Epic Games Store tokens automatically instead of forcing a re-login
  * Speed up Epic Games Store library sync by batching catalog requests
  * Hide Fab and Unreal Engine editor resources from the Epic Games Store library
  * Add "Kill all Wine processes" menu option
  * Make the Lutris.net login sync banner dismissable
  * Add links to the issue tracker from the main menu and the About dialog
  * Show the default Wine version in System Information
  * Honor a custom RetroArch cores directory in the libretro runner
  * Update the Ruffle runner to release 0.6.0
  * Follow the desktop (KDE, GNOME) proxy settings for downloads and API requests
  * Use GE-Proton through umu as the default for installers instead of downloading a Wine build
  * Download GE-Proton releases pinned by an installer script from GitHub
  * Allow regedit files to delete single registry values
  * Show the install location page when an installer script uses $GAMEDIR
  * Enable DXVK-Sarek on Proton runners when Vulkan < 1.3
  * Add sorting and filtering to Uncategorized, Missing, and Running views
  * Use cover art for grid view and banners for list view by default
  * Lazy-load libretro cores and MAME systems to avoid UI stalls
  * Defer GPU detection and library checks to speed up application startup
  * Performance improvements for large game libraries
  * Fix the Xenia runner download URL and launch command
  * Fix itch.io ARM vs x86 upload selection
  * Fix $RESOLUTION on KDE/Wayland with fractional scaling
  * Fix GPU detection in Flatpak
  * Fix crash when closing Add Games dialog with Escape
  * Fix optional libretro firmware incorrectly treated as required
  * Fix favorites view not updating when removing a game from favorites
  * Fix service games being installed as a second library entry
  * Fix Steam shortcut creation from the installer
  * Fix nested archives being extracted automatically, which broke some Humble Bundle installers
  * Fix prefer_system_libs being ignored in installer execute steps
  * Fix a game's GE-Proton (Latest) choice being overridden by the runner's Wine version
  * Don't launch a game when its Wine version is missing
  * Fix virtual desktop options being applied to Proton prefixes
  * Fix Wine's Templates folder staying linked to ~/Templates in sandboxed prefixes
  * Fix the launch configuration dialog not showing after 'lutris -i' or a lutris: link
  * Fix files that could not be trashed being reported as moved to the trash
  * Fix erratic download speed display
  * Fix imported EA App games sharing the same slug
  * Fix detection of installed Epic Games Store base games
  * Fix the Steam API key being logged when the library is empty
  * Fix crashes on malformed vulkaninfo, Steam and Ubisoft data
  * Report real return codes for installer commands and games (1 rather than 256); installer
    scripts using the old values in 'return_code' still work
  * Fix 'lutris -e' never exiting after its command finishes, and make it exit with the
    command's return code
  * Added Swedish (sv) translation
  * Added Galician (gl_ES) translation
  * Added Traditional Chinese (zh_TW) translation
  * Updated el, fr, pt_BR and zh_CN translations
  * Add experimental AppImage packaging
  * Add a shell.nix development environment for NixOS
